== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Limit, also identified as [[Iteration 216]], is a world that underwent a violent merger with the world of [[Harrow]]. Before this event, Limit was characterized by a declining ecosystem, local physics breakdowns, and a population being decimated by insectoid monsters and a mystical plague. The world was inhabited by beings known as [[Terava]], who appeared to be perfect humans but were actually natural energy projections. Following the collision of the two worlds, much of the landscape changed; for example, a large machine in Limit became part of a desert in [[Harrow]]. The population of the planet was significantly reduced during the merger, leaving only a small fraction of its original billions of inhabitants alive.}}
